craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Drawn-bow shown; cause-deer deer-pierced (mṛgavat per UNC); You-close. Rejected: (a) deer-like→like-a-deer → killed raw. Read aloud: DRAWN-bow, NOCKED-arr-ow-SHOWN … PIERCED deer-LIKE — YOU.

lines: Drawn bow, nocked arrow shown — Brahmā, Viṣṇu, Rudra-lords with Sadākhya-Śivas —
by power the cause-deer pierced deer-like — You.

reads_against.argmap: What is pierced like a deer? → Bow-shown pierces cause-deer deer-like.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
